core_categories: Consumer Electronics Retail; Cameras & Photography; Home Appliances; Personal Care; Daily Necessities; Pharmaceuticals & Cosmetics
specialty_focus: Bic Camera Inc. is a major Japanese consumer electronics retailer chain operating 45 stores across 17 prefectures. It sells a wide range of products including electronics, cameras, watches, shavers, hair dryers, medicine, cosmetics, daily necessities, and more. The company functions as a primary retail distributor for major global and domestic electronics manufacturers, but it does not specifically specialize in wearable medical devices.
